high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a news or financial publication. The content appears to be about investors who have traveled to Hangzhou to meet with the police and provide evidence regarding a company called Yongkun. The article mentions that these investors have also used social media platforms like Douyin (China's version of TikTok) to claim that the company lost their life savings. The hashtag "yongkungold" has gained significant traction on Douyin, drawing about 30 million views.
